question: In what form should the fire be contemplated and worshipped?
premises: The fire is described as golden-colored and spotless.
The fire is described as well-kindled.
The fire is described as facing all directions.
inference: One should worship the fire while contemplating it as golden-colored, spotless, well-kindled, and facing all directions.
plain_english: One should worship it thus as golden-colored, spotless, well-kindled, and facing in all directions.
